settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: The privacy policy and data protection notice will be available here soon.
settings.aboutDescription: NoteFindr analyzes the leading melody in your audio and turns it into sheet music. You'll get the best results from clear, single-instrument, clean recordings. On multi-instrument, noisy, or unclear tracks, the result may be incomplete or inaccurate. Piano uses a dedicated model and delivers the highest accuracy; for guitar, saz, violin, and oud the results are a solid starting draft.
